import json, math, statistics
from collections import defaultdict
import novamind_api as nm

day = nm.vars.current_day
print('DAY', day)

def q(sql):
    try:
        r=nm.query(sql)
        rows=r.get('rows', r)
        if r.get('warning'): print('WARNING', r.get('warning'))
        return rows
    except Exception as e:
        print('QUERY ERR', sql, e)
        return []

def p(title, rows, maxn=20):
    print('\n###', title, 'n=', len(rows))
    for row in rows[:maxn]: print(row)
    if len(rows)>maxn: print('...')

# Cash/ledger summaries
p('cash', q('SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) AS cash FROM ledger'))
p('ledger day 218-224 by category', q('''SELECT category, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) amt FROM ledger WHERE day>217 AND day<=224 GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt DESC'''))
p('ledger daily by category', q('''SELECT day, category, ROUND(SUM(amount),2) amt FROM ledger WHERE day>217 AND day<=224 GROUP BY day, category ORDER BY day, category'''), 120)
p('ledger last 14 days categories', q('''SELECT day, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN category='subscription_payment' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) sub,
ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN category='operations' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) ops,
ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN category='development' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) dev,
ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN category='advertising' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) ads,
ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN category='compute' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) compute,
ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN category='capacity' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) cap,
ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN category='lead_acquisition_cost' THEN amount ELSE 0 END),2) lead,
ROUND(SUM(amount),2) net
FROM ledger WHERE day>210 AND day<=224 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day'''), 30)

# Active subscriptions by group/plan
p('active individual subs by group/plan', q('''SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price),2) mrr, ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price),2) avg_price, ROUND(AVG(224-s.start_day),1) avg_age
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id, s.plan'''), 100)
p('active individual totals by group', q('''SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price),2) mrr, ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price),2) avg_price
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY n DESC'''), 50)
p('active plan mix total', q('''SELECT s.plan, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price),2) mrr, ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price),2) avgp
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY s.plan ORDER BY s.plan'''))

# Billing schedule upcoming
p('upcoming billing next 30 days (active small)', q('''SELECT billing_day_mod30 AS mod, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(effective_price),2) bill_amt
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY billing_day_mod30 ORDER BY billing_day_mod30'''), 40)
# next 7 mod values
mods=[(day+i)%30 for i in range(1,8)]
mods_str=','.join(map(str,mods))
p(f'next7 billing mods {mods}', q(f'''SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price),2) amt
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.customer_type='small' AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN ({mods_str})
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY amt DESC'''), 100)

# Cancellations
p('cancels day>217 by group/plan/status', q('''SELECT c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) cancels, ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price),2) avg_price, ROUND(AVG(s.end_day-s.start_day),1) avg_life
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>217 AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY cancels DESC'''), 100)
p('cancels daily by group', q('''SELECT s.end_day day, c.group_id, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>217 AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY s.end_day, c.group_id ORDER BY s.end_day, n DESC'''), 100)
p('cancels by billing mod', q('''SELECT s.billing_day_mod30 mod, c.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price),2) avgp FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>217 AND c.customer_type='small'
GROUP BY s.billing_day_mod30, c.group_id, s.plan ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 50'''), 60)

# New leads/subs conversion by group/source/plan
p('new individual leads created>217 by group/source/status', q('''SELECT c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, COALESCE(s.status,'no_sub') status, COUNT(*) n
FROM customers c LEFT JOIN subscriptions s USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND c.created_day>217
GROUP BY c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, COALESCE(s.status,'no_sub') ORDER BY c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, status'''), 200)
p('new subscribed individual start>217 by group/source/plan', q('''SELECT c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, s.plan, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(s.effective_price),2) mrr, ROUND(AVG(s.effective_price),2) avgp
FROM customers c JOIN subscriptions s USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND s.start_day>217 AND s.status='subscribed'
GROUP BY c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, s.plan ORDER BY c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, s.plan'''), 200)
p('new leads aggregate by group/source conv', q('''SELECT c.group_id, c.acquisition_source, COUNT(*) leads,
SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) subs,
ROUND(1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),3) conv,
ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END),2) active_mrr
FROM customers c LEFT JOIN subscriptions s USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.customer_type='small' AND c.created_day>217
GROUP BY c.group_id, c.acquisition_source ORDER BY active_mrr DESC'''), 200)

# Issues
p('open issues by group', q('''SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) open, ROUND(AVG(days_open),1) avg_days, SUM(CASE WHEN days_open>7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) gt7, SUM(CASE WHEN days_open>14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) gt14, MAX(days_open) maxd
FROM issues WHERE status='open' GROUP BY group_id ORDER BY open DESC'''), 50)
p('issues opened/resolved daily S2', q('''SELECT d.day,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues i WHERE i.group_id='S2' AND i.open_day=d.day) opened,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues i WHERE i.group_id='S2' AND i.resolved_day=d.day) resolved
FROM (SELECT 218 day UNION SELECT 219 UNION SELECT 220 UNION SELECT 221 UNION SELECT 222 UNION SELECT 223 UNION SELECT 224) d ORDER BY d.day'''), 20)
p('issues opened/resolved daily all', q('''SELECT d.day,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues i WHERE i.open_day=d.day) opened,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM issues i WHERE i.resolved_day=d.day) resolved
FROM (SELECT 218 day UNION SELECT 219 UNION SELECT 220 UNION SELECT 221 UNION SELECT 222 UNION SELECT 223 UNION SELECT 224) d ORDER BY d.day'''), 20)

# Enterprise latest turns, subscriptions statuses
p('enterprise subscription statuses', q('''SELECT c.group_id, s.status, COUNT(*) threads, SUM(s.seat_count) seats, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN s.effective_price*s.seat_count ELSE 0 END),2) mrr
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.customer_type='large'
GROUP BY c.group_id, s.status ORDER BY c.group_id, s.status'''), 100)
p('enterprise latest open/customer-last needing response', q('''WITH latest AS (
 SELECT customer_id, MAX(message_id) AS max_mid FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT et.message_id, et.customer_id, c.group_id, et.thread_type, et.turn_number, et.sender, et.day, et.seat_count, s.status sub_status, s.plan, s.effective_price,
substr(et.message_text,1,220) msg, substr(et.offer_json,1,220) offer
FROM latest l JOIN enterprise_turns et ON et.message_id=l.max_mid
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=et.customer_id
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=et.customer_id
WHERE et.closed=0 AND et.sender!='agent' AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status!='lost')
ORDER BY et.day, et.message_id'''), 200)
p('enterprise latest open all last 120', q('''WITH latest AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(message_id) max_mid FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT et.message_id, et.customer_id, c.group_id, et.thread_type, et.turn_number, et.sender, et.day, et.seat_count, s.status, s.plan, s.effective_price, substr(et.message_text,1,160) msg, substr(et.offer_json,1,160) offer
FROM latest l JOIN enterprise_turns et ON et.message_id=l.max_mid JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=et.customer_id LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=et.customer_id
ORDER BY et.day DESC, et.message_id DESC LIMIT 120'''), 120)

# Research projects
try:
    print('\n### research projects')
    for r in nm.research.list_research_projects(): print(r)
except Exception as e: print('research err', e)
try:
    print('\n### cost info')
    print(json.dumps(nm.infrastructure.get_cost_info(), indent=2)[:5000])
except Exception as e: print('cost err', e)
try:
    print('\n### market overview')
    print(json.dumps(nm.market.get_market_overview(), indent=2)[:10000])
except Exception as e: print('market err', e)
try:
    print('\n### social posts last 10')
    posts=nm.analytics.get_social_posts(days=7, limit=100)
    for post in posts[-20:] if isinstance(posts,list) else posts.get('posts', [])[-20:]: print(post)
except Exception as e: print('social err', e)

import json
import novamind_api as nm

def q(sql):
    try:
        r=nm.query(sql); rows=r.get('rows', r); print('\nSQL', sql.split('\n')[0][:80], 'rows', len(rows));
        for row in rows[:200]: print(row)
        if len(rows)>200: print('...')
        return rows
    except Exception as e: print('ERR', e)

print('day', nm.vars.current_day)
# current overrides snapshots
q("""SELECT id, day, tool_name, setting_type, substr(settings_json,1,2000) js FROM config_overrides WHERE id IN (SELECT MAX(id) FROM config_overrides GROUP BY setting_type) ORDER BY setting_type""")
q("""SELECT * FROM config_history WHERE day>=217 ORDER BY day""")
# daily usage/service
q("""SELECT sd.day,total_usage_units,p95_ms,error_rate,downtime_minutes,capacity_tier,capacity_units FROM service_day sd WHERE day>217 ORDER BY day""")
q("""SELECT du.day,c.group_id,s.plan,COUNT(*) users,SUM(usage_units) units,ROUND(AVG(usage_units),1) avg_units FROM daily_usage du JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN subscriptions s USING(customer_id) WHERE du.day>217 AND s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY du.day,c.group_id,s.plan ORDER BY du.day, units DESC""")
q("""SELECT c.group_id,s.plan,COUNT(DISTINCT du.customer_id) users,SUM(usage_units) units,ROUND(SUM(usage_units)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT du.customer_id)/7,1) avg_daily_per_user FROM daily_usage du JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) JOIN subscriptions s USING(customer_id) WHERE du.day>217 AND s.status='subscribed' GROUP BY c.group_id,s.plan ORDER BY units DESC""")
# ad channels exact
q("""SELECT day,channel_id,group_id,leads_generated,spend,ROUND(leads_generated*1.0/spend,4) lpd FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day>217 ORDER BY day, channel_id, group_id""")
q("""SELECT channel_id,group_id,SUM(leads_generated) leads,SUM(spend) spend,ROUND(SUM(leads_generated)*1.0/SUM(spend),4) lpd FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day>217 GROUP BY channel_id,group_id ORDER BY spend DESC""")
# social and agent posts/notifications
q("""SELECT post_id,day,group_id,customer_type,persona_name,substr(content,1,500) content,reply_to_agent_post_id FROM social_media_posts WHERE day>=218 ORDER BY day DESC, post_id DESC LIMIT 100""")
q("""SELECT * FROM agent_social_media_posts ORDER BY agent_post_id DESC LIMIT 20""")
q("""SELECT * FROM notifications WHERE day>=218 ORDER BY day, notification_id LIMIT 200""")
# research projects raw table and API
q("""SELECT * FROM research_projects ORDER BY expected_completion_day""")
print('\nAPI research')
res=nm.research.list_research_projects(); print(json.dumps(res,indent=2)[:20000])
# enterprise latest all with statuses after old offers maybe responses? show lost by latest group, turn.
q("""SELECT c.group_id, s.status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(s.seat_count) seats FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE c.customer_type='large' AND s.start_day>=217 GROUP BY c.group_id,s.status ORDER BY c.group_id,s.status""")
# group info maybe not tables? 
q("""SELECT * FROM group_info_levels ORDER BY group_id""")
# prior forecasts around day217 actual compare
q("""SELECT * FROM predictions WHERE submit_day>=196 ORDER BY submit_day,horizon_days""")

import json
from pathlib import Path
import novamind_api as nm

day=nm.vars.current_day
print('Day', day, 'actions')

# 1) Cut weak ad experiments; keep only S2 content marketing which paid back in first cash.
print('Setting targeted ad spend...')
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={
    'content_marketing': {'S2': 40000.0}
}))

# 2) Increase S2 ops surge since aged/backlog and social support complaints worsened.
ops_by_group = {
    'S2': 260000.0,
    'D_S07': 2000.0,
    'S3': 2000.0,
    'D_S04': 1000.0,
    'S1': 500.0,
    'D_S03': 300.0,
    'D_S05': 300.0,
    'D_S06': 500.0,
    'D_S10': 300.0,
    'E1': 1000.0,
    'E2': 1000.0,
    'E3': 1000.0,
    'D_E02': 1000.0,
    'D_E08': 1000.0,
    'D_E09': 1000.0,
    'D_E01': 500.0,
    'D_E03': 500.0,
    'D_E07': 500.0,
    'D_E10': 500.0,
}
print('Setting targeted ops spend total', sum(ops_by_group.values()))
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(by_group=ops_by_group))

# Keep current dev spend profile; re-assert so the full intended state is explicit.
dev_by_group = {
    'S2': 10000.0,
    'D_S07': 2000.0,
    'S3': 2000.0,
    'D_S04': 2000.0,
    'D_S03': 500.0,
    'D_S05': 500.0,
    'D_S06': 500.0,
    'D_S10': 500.0,
    'S1': 500.0,
    'D_E10': 500.0,
}
print('Setting targeted dev spend total', sum(dev_by_group.values()))
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend=dev_by_group))

# 3) Retention rescue: target only S2 full-price B/C customers billing in the next 7 days.
# Broad group promotions would waste dollars on already-discounted cohorts; this rolls targeted
# by-customer promos forward week by week. Persist recipients in a file for future weeks.
ret_file = Path('s2_retention_promos.json')
if ret_file.exists():
    promo_map = json.loads(ret_file.read_text())
else:
    promo_map = {}
mods = [(day+i)%30 for i in range(1,8)]
mods_sql = ','.join(map(str, mods))
rows = nm.query(f'''
SELECT s.customer_id, s.plan, s.effective_price
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed'
  AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN ({mods_sql})
  AND ((s.plan='B' AND s.effective_price>=130) OR (s.plan='C' AND s.effective_price>=220))
''')['rows']
added=0
for r in rows:
    cid=str(r['customer_id'])
    amt = 20.0 if r['plan']=='B' else 60.0
    if promo_map.get(cid) != amt:
        promo_map[cid]=amt; added += 1
ret_file.write_text(json.dumps(promo_map, sort_keys=True))
print('S2 retention by-customer promos: added', added, 'total', len(promo_map), 'next7 candidates', len(rows), 'mods', mods)
# Preserve existing group-plan promos while setting by-customer map.
existing_group_plan = {
    'S1': {'A': 30.0},
    'D_S03': {'A': 30.0},
    'D_S06': {'A': 20.0},
    'D_S05': {'A': 10.0},
    'D_S10': {'A': 10.0},
    'D_S07': {'B': 90.0, 'C': 170.0},
    'S3': {'B': 40.0, 'C': 80.0},
    'D_S04': {'A': 20.0, 'B': 90.0, 'C': 160.0},
}
print(nm.pricing.set_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group={}, by_group_plan=existing_group_plan, by_customer=promo_map))

# 4) Reply to all new enterprise leads before timeout. Offer conservative month-to-month prices,
# below noisy WTP estimates, preserving gross margin and maximizing acceptance/reputation.
need = nm.query('''WITH latest AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(message_id) max_mid FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT et.customer_id, c.group_id, et.day, et.seat_count
FROM latest l JOIN enterprise_turns et ON et.message_id=l.max_mid
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=et.customer_id
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=et.customer_id
WHERE et.closed=0 AND et.sender!='agent' AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status!='lost')
ORDER BY et.day, et.customer_id''')['rows']
price_offers = {
    'E1': [['A',14.0], ['B',18.0], ['C',22.0]],
    'E2': [['B',59.0], ['C',79.0]],
    'E3': [['B',79.0], ['C',99.0]],
    'D_E02': [['A',39.0], ['B',59.0], ['C',79.0]],
    'D_E07': [['B',129.0], ['C',169.0]],
    'D_E08': [['B',99.0], ['C',129.0]],
    'D_E09': [['A',49.0], ['B',69.0], ['C',89.0]],
    'D_E01': [['B',99.0], ['C',129.0]],
    'D_E03': [['B',119.0], ['C',149.0]],
    'D_E10': [['B',39.0], ['C',49.0]],
}
deals=[]
for r in need:
    offers = price_offers.get(r['group_id'], [['B',59.0], ['C',79.0]])
    deals.append([r['customer_id'], offers])
print('Enterprise deals to send', len(deals))
if deals:
    print(nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals))

# 5) Public support reply; concise, concrete, avoids claiming the backlog is fixed.
content = 'Rachel/Dr. Foster: a 3–10 day silence is unacceptable. Today every S2 API/GL/legal blocker >48h gets a named owner + ETA, we’re adding another S2 support surge, and frozen API/docs gates stay until aged cases fall—not just ticket volume. DM case ID; I’ll route it.'
print('Social post length', len(content))
try:
    print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(content=content, reply_to_post_id=612))
except Exception as e:
    print('social post error', e)

print('Actions complete')

import json
from pathlib import Path
import novamind_api as nm

day=nm.vars.current_day
ret_file=Path('s2_retention_promos.json')
promo_map=json.loads(ret_file.read_text()) if ret_file.exists() else {}
mods=[(day+i)%30 for i in range(1,8)]
mods_sql=','.join(map(str,mods))
count_sql=f'''SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) b,
SUM(CASE WHEN s.plan='C' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) c
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed'
  AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN ({mods_sql})
  AND ((s.plan='B' AND s.effective_price>=130) OR (s.plan='C' AND s.effective_price>=220))'''
print('candidate count', nm.query(count_sql)['rows'][0])
all_rows=[]
limit=4000
offset=0
while True:
    rows=nm.query(f'''
    SELECT s.customer_id, s.plan, s.effective_price
    FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
    WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed'
      AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN ({mods_sql})
      AND ((s.plan='B' AND s.effective_price>=130) OR (s.plan='C' AND s.effective_price>=220))
    ORDER BY s.customer_id
    LIMIT {limit} OFFSET {offset}
    ''')['rows']
    if not rows: break
    all_rows.extend(rows)
    if len(rows)<limit: break
    offset += limit
print('fetched', len(all_rows))
added=0
for r in all_rows:
    cid=str(r['customer_id'])
    amt=20.0 if r['plan']=='B' else 60.0
    if promo_map.get(cid)!=amt:
        promo_map[cid]=amt; added+=1
ret_file.write_text(json.dumps(promo_map, sort_keys=True))
print('promo_map total', len(promo_map), 'added now', added)
existing_group_plan={
    'S1': {'A': 30.0},
    'D_S03': {'A': 30.0},
    'D_S06': {'A': 20.0},
    'D_S05': {'A': 10.0},
    'D_S10': {'A': 10.0},
    'D_S07': {'B': 90.0, 'C': 170.0},
    'S3': {'B': 40.0, 'C': 80.0},
    'D_S04': {'A': 20.0, 'B': 90.0, 'C': 160.0},
}
res=nm.pricing.set_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group={}, by_group_plan=existing_group_plan, by_customer=promo_map)
print('set_promotion ok; by_customer count', len(res.get('by_customer',{})), 'group_plan keys', sorted(res.get('by_group_plan',{}).keys()))

# NovaMind CEO Memory

## Persistent rules / API gotchas
- `next-week` requires rationale + 12 forecast numbers; update MEMORY before advancing.
- Active subscription SQL status is `subscribed`; individual `customers.customer_type='small'`, enterprise `large`; cash = `SELECT SUM(amount) FROM ledger`.
- `set_targeted_ad_spend` is a FULL ad budget override (include every channel/group). `set_daily_spend` only sets global ops/dev; targeted ops/dev use analytics API.
- **Targeted ops API:** despite docs, use `nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={...})`; `by_group=` raises TypeError.
- Query results cap at 5,000 rows. For large by-customer ops/promos use `COUNT` then `ORDER BY ... LIMIT/OFFSET` paging. Day224 first promo query truncated; fixed with paging.
- Issues table uses `open_day` and `days_open`; dashboard issue count differs from SQL. Query aged backlog by joining subscriptions when needed.
- Social posting: `nm.marketing.post_social_media(...)`; `agent_social_media_posts` pk `agent_post_id`; notifications pk `notification_id`.
- Existing subs keep `listed_price` from signup; lead promos affect first payment but not subscription table. Ongoing promos affect billing evaluation and `effective_price` at billing.
- Enterprise: stale `enterprise_turns.closed=0` rows can remain after lost leads. Reply same week only if latest open row sender is customer/system and sub is not lost. Do not reject active/renewal/churn-prevention unless willing to churn.
- No daily scripts registered. Manually handle enterprise replies and capacity weekly.

## Day 224 (Week 32) post-action state
- Start dashboard: cash $3.378M; 140,826 individual subs; 0 enterprise seats; dashboard open issues 9,297. Cash unchanged after actions (no immediate spend). Week 218-224 net only **+$262k** from day217 post-action cash due high ops + churn.
- Active individual MRR **$14.831M**. S2 **138,922 / $14.652M**; D_S07 1,240/$100.5k; S3 390/$62.8k; D_S04 175/$13.3k; D_S10 31/$2.4k; S1 29/$696; D_S03 23/$552; D_S05 14/$866; D_S06 2/$78.
- Current config: prices **A49/B139/C259**, tiers **A1/B2/C3**, quotas **A500/B1500/C4000**, capacity **tier6**, in-app ads off. C tier3 caused only modest C churn/downgrades; keep for compute savings. Do **not** raise A tier casually: A2 quality would match B and could trigger mass B downgrades because average usage is below A quota.
- Week ledger 218-224: subscription $2.965M; ops $1.655M; ads $385k; compute $317k; capacity $196k; dev $141k; lead $9k. Current post-action daily costs approx ops $276.4k + dev $20.2k + ads $40k + cap $28k + compute ~$45k = ~$410k/d.
- Capacity tier6 still needed: daily usage 29.2M, 30.6M, 29.3M, 26.4M, 15.7M, 15.5M, 25.7M; tier5 only 25M, so do not downshift yet.

## Day 224 actions taken
- **Ads cut to $40k/d total**, only `content_marketing -> S2 $40k/d`. Cut S3/D_S04/D_S07 tests: week payback poor (D_S04 2 subs on $35k; S3 $8.6k MRR on $35k; D_S07 $4.7k MRR on $35k). S2 content remained first-cash positive: 5,972 leads, 3,963 subs, $535.6k booked MRR on $280k ad spend.
- **Ops increased** because SQL/Social support worsened: targeted ops now S2 **$260k/d**; D_S07 $2k, S3 $2k, D_S04 $1k, S1 $500, D_S03 $300, D_S05 $300, D_S06 $500, D_S10 $300; E1/E2/E3/D_E02/D_E08/D_E09 $1k each; D_E01/D_E03/D_E07/D_E10 $500 each. Global ops $1.5k. Total ops **$276.4k/d**. Trim only after aged cases and support social fall materially.
- Dev reasserted unchanged: targeted **$19k/d** (S2 $10k; D_S07/S3/D_S04 $2k each; D_S03/D_S05/D_S06/D_S10/S1/D_E10 $500 each) + global $1.2k = **$20.2k/d**.
- **Targeted retention promos:** created/updated `s2_retention_promos.json` with **9,079** S2 full-price B/C customers billing mods 15-21. Promo amounts: B $20 (139→119), C $60 (259→199). Must preserve this file and add future weekly full-price cohorts with LIMIT/OFFSET; call `set_promotion` with full by_customer map + existing group_plan promos. Rationale: S2 last-30 churn by price: B139 15.8% vs B100-129 3.5%; C259 6.4% vs C160-219 3.3%. A churn high even at low price, so no A promo beyond existing.
- Ongoing group-plan promos preserved: S1 A30; D_S03 A30; D_S06 A20; D_S05 A10; D_S10 A10; D_S07 B90/C170; S3 B40/C80; D_S04 A20/B90/C160. Lead promos unchanged: S1 5, S2 15, S3 40, D_S07 60, D_S04 80, D_S03 5, D_S05/D_S06/D_S10 10.
- Replied to **15 new enterprise leads** (8,677 seats) on day224. Offers: E1 A14/B18/C22; E2 B59/C79; E3 B79/C99; D_E02 A39/B59/C79; D_E07 B129/C169; D_E09 A49/B69/C89. No customer-last enterprise threads remain after action.
- Social post **agent_post_id 33** replying to post 612: acknowledged 3-10 day S2 support silence; named-owner+ETA for >48h API/GL/legal blockers; added S2 support surge; frozen API/docs gates until aged cases fall.
- No market research or R&D started; cash too low for t11 this week.

## Support / churn / pricing notes
- SQL open issues day224: **16,933** total; S2 **16,404 open**, avg 14.9d, **6,109 >7d**, **5,490 >14d** (worse vs day217: 13,116 open; 5,490 >7; 4,950 >14). D_S07 332, S3 117, D_S04 51.
- Open issues by sub status: all active S2 issues are day0 (A 4,838, B 3,889, C 219); aged issues mostly cancelled S2 A/B (A 5,753 open avg 34.9d; B 1,682 avg 25.1d). Reputation/social still bad, so keep surge.
- S2 issues opened/resolved daily 218-224: 7,043/6,952; 7,287/6,985; 7,342/7,195; 7,877/7,127; 8,187/7,630; 8,774/7,966; 9,156/8,523. Resolution still behind openings.
- Week cancellations: 10,644 total; S2 10,589 (A 6,995, B 3,314, C 280); D_S07 52; S3 3. S2 daily cancels after day219: 2,197, 2,202, 1,818, 1,711, 1,607. Full-price cohorts are the problem: week exposure mods8-14 churn A ~54-63%, B139 23.3%, C259 12.4%, discounted B/C ~3%.
- Recent social day224 posts (#609-613) still complain about 3-10 day S2 support silence and healthcare quality regression. Competitor posts days219-222 show big quality-pressure events (~0.34-0.44 boosts); t5/t6 boosts should help but keep watching.

## Funnel / segment notes
- S2 content week: 5,972 paid leads / 3,963 subs (66.4% conv, down from 87.5% prior week), booked MRR $535.6k. Network S2 1,724 leads / 1,149 subs (66.6%), $156.2k MRR. Keep S2 content $40k/d while first-cash ROI remains positive, but watch market-cap saturation and support.
- Paid tests cut: D_S04 content generated 1,288 leads but only 2 subs; D_S04 search/linkedin zero subs; S3 search/content/linkedin low conv 2.5-3.7%; D_S07 search/linkedin/content low MRR and payback.
- Low-WTP organic after A promos (S1/D_S03/D_S05/D_S06/D_S10) still essentially zero conversion; leave promos but do not spend ads there.

## Enterprise
- Day224 offers sent to 15 new leads: E1 1 lead/63 seats; E3 5 leads/5,624 seats; D_E02 3/1,165 seats; D_E07 1/731 seats; D_E09 4/331 seats; E2 1/763 seats.
- If counters/acceptance/churn-prevention arrive, respond same week. Since all contracts month-to-month, prioritize acceptance/reputation; enterprise compute margins remain good at offered prices. D_E07 WTP est $196, D_E02 $82, D_E09 $106, E3 $104, E2 $88, E1 $20 (noisy).
- Many old day217 offers remain agent-last lead or lost; do not spam unless customer responds.

## R&D pipeline / capital allocation
- Completed boosts total notable: t1 total +0.1636, t2 +0.0619, t3 +0.1023, t4 +0.1078, t5_1 +0.0840, t6_1 +0.5559, **t10_1 +1.7232**.
- In progress: **t5_2 day226 +0.1996**, **t6_2 day233 +0.4556**, **t7_1 day239 +0.001 dud**, **t8_1 day280 +0.6261**, **t9_1 day417 +0.2201 weak/late**, **t10_2 day535 +0.9165 too late/no final value**.
- Do not rely on t10_2. Consider **t11 cost $2.5M mean140d** only when pre-action cash is safely >~$6M and post-action reserve stays >~$3M. Consider t12 later if cashflow strong; always record sampled completion/boost immediately.

## Day 231 checklist
- Verify t5_2 completed day226 and quality/cash vs forecast. Check day231 cash and whether S2 B/C by-customer promos reduced full-price churn for mods15-21.
- Add next weekly S2 full-price B/C billing cohort to `s2_retention_promos.json` using paged query; preserve old by_customer map when calling `set_promotion`.
- Check S2 support: open, >7d, >14d, active aged issues, opened/resolved, cancellations, social post #33 reactions. Keep/increase ops if aged still rising; trim only after clear improvement.
- Check enterprise inbox and statuses/accepted seats/MRR; reply same week.
- Re-evaluate S2 content ROI, conversion, market cap; keep if first-cash positive. Do not restart weak D_S04/S3/D_S07 ads without new evidence.
- Capacity tier6 remains needed unless peak daily usage stays well below 25M with margin.
- If cash near/above $6M and support is not catastrophic, consider t11; otherwise wait.

## Forecasts to submit from day224 cash $3.378M
- day231 point **$3.95M** (CI **$3.25M-$4.90M**).
- day252 point **$6.0M** (CI **$4.0M-$8.8M**) assuming no t11 before day252; if t11 starts earlier, cash can be ~$2.5M lower.
- day308 point **$13.5M** (CI **$6.5M-$28.0M**) includes t5/t6/t8 boosts, rolling retention promos, possible t11/t12 spend, and uncertain enterprise.
- day406 point **$36.0M** (CI **$14.0M-$85.0M**) highly dependent on S2 churn/support recovery, enterprise close rate, future R&D timing/samples, and competitor events.

from pathlib import Path
import novamind_api as nm

day=nm.vars.current_day
print('Day', day, 'week33 actions')

# Keep list prices/model/quotas/capacity; reassert capacity and global ops/dev.
try:
    print('capacity', nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=6))
except Exception as e: print('capacity set error', e)
try:
    print('daily spend', nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=1500.0, development=1200.0))
except Exception as e: print('daily spend error', e)

# 1) S2 content remains strongly first-cash-positive, but we are near cap/support limits.

ad_spend={'content_marketing': {'S2': 50000.0}}

}
print('targeted ops total', sum(ops_by_group.values()))
print('ops', nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend=ops_by_group))

# 3) S2 quality still drives cancellations/social complaints; increase targeted S2 dev.
dev_by_group = {
    'S2': 20000.0,
    'D_S07': 2000.0,

    'D_S03': 500.0,

}
print('targeted dev total', sum(dev_by_group.values()))
print('dev', nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend=dev_by_group))

# 4) Retention pricing: day224 B $20 rescue was too weak (B listed $139 cohorts still churned heavily).
# Use a broader by-customer rescue for S2 B listed at $139 -> $99 on renewal; preserve C rescue only for prior/next7 C.
ret_file = Path('s2_retention_promos.json')
old_map = json.loads(ret_file.read_text()) if ret_file.exists() else {}
mods = [(day+i)%30 for i in range(1,8)]
mods_sql = ','.join(map(str, mods))
promo_map = {}

def paged(sql_base, limit=4000):
    out=[]; offset=0
    while True:
        rows=nm.query(sql_base + f"\nORDER BY s.customer_id LIMIT {limit} OFFSET {offset}")['rows']
        out.extend(rows)
        if len(rows) < limit: break
        offset += limit
    return out

# All active S2 B subscribers whose listed price is the current high $139 get a $40 ongoing promo.
b_count = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='B' AND s.listed_price>=139""")['rows'][0]['n']
b_rows = paged("""SELECT s.customer_id, s.plan FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='B' AND s.listed_price>=139""")
for r in b_rows:
    promo_map[str(r['customer_id'])] = 40.0

# C: keep/upgrade active C customers already on a promo, plus full-price C billing in next 7 days.
c_keep_count = nm.query("""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='C' AND s.listed_price>=259 AND s.promotion>0""")['rows'][0]['n']
c_keep_rows = paged("""SELECT s.customer_id, s.plan FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='C' AND s.listed_price>=259 AND s.promotion>0""")
for r in c_keep_rows:
    promo_map[str(r['customer_id'])] = 60.0
c_next_count = nm.query(f"""SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='C' AND s.listed_price>=259
  AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN ({mods_sql}) AND s.effective_price>=220""")['rows'][0]['n']
c_next_rows = paged(f"""SELECT s.customer_id, s.plan FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='C' AND s.listed_price>=259
  AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN ({mods_sql}) AND s.effective_price>=220""")
for r in c_next_rows:
    promo_map[str(r['customer_id'])] = 60.0

ret_file.write_text(json.dumps(promo_map, sort_keys=True))
print('promo_map rebuilt: old', len(old_map), 'new', len(promo_map), 'B high-listed count/fetched', b_count, len(b_rows), 'C keep', c_keep_count, len(c_keep_rows), 'C next7', c_next_count, len(c_next_rows), 'mods', mods)
existing_group_plan = {
    'S1': {'A': 30.0},
    'D_S03': {'A': 30.0},
    'D_S06': {'A': 20.0},
    'D_S05': {'A': 10.0},
    'D_S10': {'A': 10.0},
    'D_S07': {'B': 90.0, 'C': 170.0},
    'S3': {'B': 40.0, 'C': 80.0},
    'D_S04': {'A': 20.0, 'B': 90.0, 'C': 160.0},
}
promo_res = nm.pricing.set_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group={}, by_group_plan=existing_group_plan, by_customer=promo_map)
print('promotion result counts: by_customer', len(promo_res.get('by_customer', {})), 'by_group_plan', sorted(promo_res.get('by_group_plan', {}).keys()))

# 5) Reply to all current customer/system-last enterprise leads. Use slightly more acceptance-oriented pricing.
need = nm.query('''WITH latest AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(message_id) max_mid FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT et.customer_id, c.group_id, et.day, et.seat_count, et.thread_type, et.turn_number
FROM latest l JOIN enterprise_turns et ON et.message_id=l.max_mid
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=et.customer_id
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=et.customer_id
WHERE et.closed=0 AND et.sender!='agent' AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status!='lost')
ORDER BY et.day, et.customer_id''')['rows']
price_offers = {
    'E1': [['A',12.0], ['B',16.0], ['C',20.0]],
    'E2': [['B',49.0], ['C',69.0]],

    'D_E01': [['B',79.0], ['C',109.0]],
    'D_E03': [['B',99.0], ['C',129.0]],
    'D_E10': [['B',29.0], ['C',39.0]],
}
deals=[]
for r in need:
    deals.append([r['customer_id'], price_offers.get(r['group_id'], [['B',49.0], ['C',69.0]])])
print('enterprise needing response', len(need), need)
if deals:
    ent_res = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals)
    print('enterprise result', ent_res)

# 6) Public support reply to the new healthcare/compliance complaint; concise, concrete, and not overclaiming.
content = 'An 8-day clinical integration ticket is a failure. Today every healthcare/compliance ticket >72h moves to one owner, audit checklist, and no billing/tech handoffs; S2 ops is up again this week. DM case ID—I will verify closure.'

try:

remain = nm.query('''WITH latest AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(message_id) max_mid FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM latest l JOIN enterprise_turns et ON et.message_id=l.max_mid

import json, math, collections
import novamind_api as nm

DAY = nm.vars.current_day
print('Day', DAY, 'week34 actions')

def q(sql):
    return nm.query(sql)['rows']

def fetch_all(base_sql, limit=5000):
    out=[]; off=0
    while True:
        rows = q(base_sql + f" LIMIT {limit} OFFSET {off}")
        out.extend(rows)
        if len(rows) < limit:
            break
        off += limit
    return out

# Core config: keep successful price/tier/quotas/capacity, scale S2 content modestly.
print('capacity', nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=6))
print('prices', nm.pricing.set_prices(A=49, B=139, C=259))
print('tiers', nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=1, B=2, C=3))
print('quotas', nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=500, B=1500, C=4000))
print('ads_strength', nm.marketing.set_ads_strength(global_strength=0.0, by_group={}))
print('daily spend', nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=1500, development=1200))
print('ad spend', nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={"content_marketing": {"S2": 60000.0}}))

# Targeted support: S2 queue is only just balancing; add modest surge. Add newly discovered groups.
ops = {
    "S2": 325000.0,
    "D_S07": 2000.0, "S3": 2000.0, "D_S04": 1000.0,
    "S1": 500.0, "D_S03": 300.0, "D_S05": 300.0, "D_S06": 500.0, "D_S10": 300.0,
    "D_S08": 500.0,
    "E1": 1000.0, "E2": 1000.0, "E3": 1000.0,
    "D_E02": 1000.0, "D_E08": 1000.0, "D_E09": 1000.0,
    "D_E01": 500.0, "D_E03": 500.0, "D_E07": 500.0, "D_E10": 500.0,
    "D_E05": 500.0,
}
print('targeted ops total', sum(ops.values()))
print('ops', nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend=ops))

# Targeted dev: keep S2 compounding; seed newly discovered D_S08/D_E05.
dev = {
    "S2": 20000.0,
    "D_S07": 2000.0, "S3": 2000.0, "D_S04": 2000.0,
    "D_S03": 500.0, "D_S05": 500.0, "D_S06": 500.0, "D_S10": 500.0, "S1": 500.0,
    "D_S08": 1000.0,
    "D_E10": 500.0, "D_E05": 500.0,
}
print('targeted dev total', sum(dev.values()))
print('dev', nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend=dev))

# Lead promotions: preserve proven group promos, add D_S08 so organic network leads can clear A-price barrier.
lead_by_group = {
    "S1": 5.0, "S2": 15.0, "S3": 40.0,
    "D_S07": 60.0, "D_S04": 80.0,
    "D_S03": 5.0, "D_S05": 10.0, "D_S06": 10.0, "D_S10": 10.0,
    "D_S08": 15.0,
}
print('lead promo', nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group=lead_by_group, by_channel={}, by_channel_group={}))

# Rebuild ongoing promos. B139 S2 gets $40; preserve active old C promos and add rolling C259 next-7 at $60.
try:
    old = json.load(open('s2_retention_promos.json'))
except FileNotFoundError:
    old = {}
mods_next7 = [(DAY+i) % 30 for i in range(1,8)]
mods_set = set(mods_next7)
by_customer = {}
# All active S2 B at current listed price get $40 retention discount.
rows_b = fetch_all("""
SELECT s.customer_id FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='B' AND s.listed_price>=139
ORDER BY s.customer_id
""")
for r in rows_b:
    by_customer[str(r['customer_id'])] = 40.0
# Preserve active S2 C promos that already existed; add rolling next-week full-price C rescue at $60.
rows_c = fetch_all("""
SELECT s.customer_id, s.billing_day_mod30, s.listed_price FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='C' AND s.listed_price>=259
ORDER BY s.customer_id
""")
old_c_preserved = 0
c_next7 = 0
for r in rows_c:
    cid = str(r['customer_id'])
    val = None
    if cid in old:
        val = float(old[cid])
        old_c_preserved += 1
    if int(r['billing_day_mod30']) in mods_set:
        val = max(val or 0.0, 60.0)
        c_next7 += 1
    if val is not None and val > 0:
        by_customer[cid] = val
by_group_plan = {
    "S1": {"A": 30.0},
    "D_S03": {"A": 30.0},
    "D_S06": {"A": 20.0},
    "D_S05": {"A": 10.0},
    "D_S10": {"A": 10.0},
    "D_S08": {"A": 10.0},
    "D_S07": {"B": 90.0, "C": 170.0},
    "S3": {"B": 40.0, "C": 80.0},
    "D_S04": {"A": 20.0, "B": 90.0, "C": 160.0},
}
json.dump(by_customer, open('s2_retention_promos.json','w'), sort_keys=True)
print('promo_map rebuilt old', len(old), 'new', len(by_customer), 'B_active', len(rows_b), 'C_active259', len(rows_c), 'C_old_preserved', old_c_preserved, 'C_next7', c_next7, 'mods', mods_next7)
promo_res = nm.pricing.set_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group={}, by_customer=by_customer, by_group_plan=by_group_plan)
print('promotion result counts: by_customer', len(promo_res.get('by_customer',{})), 'by_group_plan', sorted(promo_res.get('by_group_plan',{}).keys()))

# Enterprise: reply to every customer/system-last open thread with aggressive month-to-month offers.
rows = q("""
WITH latest AS (
 SELECT customer_id, MAX(message_id) AS max_mid FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT et.customer_id, c.group_id, et.day, et.thread_type, et.turn_number, et.seat_count
FROM latest l JOIN enterprise_turns et ON et.message_id=l.max_mid
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=et.customer_id
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=et.customer_id
WHERE et.closed=0 AND et.sender!='agent' AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status!='lost')
ORDER BY et.day, et.message_id
""")
print('enterprise needing response', len(rows), rows[:10])
offers_by_group = {
    'E1': [["A", 8.0], ["B", 12.0], ["C", 16.0]],
    'E2': [["A", 29.0], ["B", 49.0], ["C", 69.0]],
    'E3': [["A", 39.0], ["B", 59.0], ["C", 79.0]],
    'D_E01': [["A", 49.0], ["B", 69.0], ["C", 89.0]],
    'D_E02': [["A", 19.0], ["B", 29.0], ["C", 49.0]],
    'D_E03': [["B", 79.0], ["C", 109.0]],
    'D_E05': [["B", 69.0], ["C", 89.0]],
    'D_E07': [["B", 99.0], ["C", 129.0]],
    'D_E08': [["A", 49.0], ["B", 69.0], ["C", 89.0]],
    'D_E09': [["A", 29.0], ["B", 49.0], ["C", 69.0]],
    'D_E10': [["B", 24.0], ["C", 34.0]],
}
deals = [[int(r['customer_id']), offers_by_group.get(r['group_id'], [["B",49.0],["C",69.0]])] for r in rows]
if deals:
    ent_res = nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals)
    print('enterprise result count', len(ent_res.get('results',[])), 'sample', ent_res.get('results',[])[:10])
else:
    print('no enterprise deals to send')

# Public accountability response to the new support complaints.
content = "You're right: 7 days is unacceptable. This week: no outage, peak p95 252ms/0.42%, and day238 resolutions finally exceeded new tickets. I'm keeping the support surge + 72h owner/audit SLA; reconciliation/contract parsing cases get named owner today. DM case ID."
try:
    post_res = nm.marketing.post_social_media(content=content, reply_to_post_id=647)
    print('social', post_res)
except Exception as e:
    print('social error', e)

# Verify no customer-last enterprise remains and cash after actions/research.
remaining = q("""
WITH latest AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(message_id) max_mid FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM latest l JOIN enterprise_turns et ON et.message_id=l.max_mid LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=et.customer_id
WHERE et.closed=0 AND et.sender!='agent' AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status!='lost')
""")
print('remaining enterprise responses needed', remaining)
print('cash after actions', q('SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) cash FROM ledger'))
print('Actions complete')

# NovaMind CEO Memory

## Persistent rules / API gotchas
- `next-week` requires rationale + 12 forecast numbers; update MEMORY before advancing.
- Active subscription SQL status is `subscribed`; individual `customers.customer_type='small'`, enterprise `large`; cash = `SELECT SUM(amount) FROM ledger`.
- `set_targeted_ad_spend` is a FULL ad budget override (include every channel/group). `set_daily_spend` only sets global ops/dev; targeted ops/dev use analytics API.
- Targeted ops API: `nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={...})`; not `by_group=`.
- Query results cap at 5,000 rows. Use `COUNT/GROUP BY` or paging with LIMIT/OFFSET for by-customer promos.
- Issues table uses `open_day` and `days_open`; dashboard issue count differs from SQL. Query aged backlog by joining subscriptions.
- Social posting: `nm.marketing.post_social_media(...)`; `agent_social_media_posts` pk `agent_post_id`.
- Existing subs keep `listed_price` from signup; ongoing promos apply at billing and update `promotion/effective_price` only for survivors. Canceled rows may still show old `promotion` even if by-customer promo existed.
- Enterprise: reply same week only if latest open row sender is customer/system and sub is not lost. Do not reject active/renewal/churn-prevention unless willing to churn. Agent-last threads can sit for many days; do not spam.
- No daily scripts registered. Manually handle enterprise replies and capacity weekly.

## Day 238 (Week 34) post-action state
- Dashboard start: cash **$4.905M**, individual subs **145,101**, enterprise seats **0**, dashboard open issues **10,923**. After 4 market-research attempts (2 successes) cash **$4.805M**.
- Weekly ledger day232-238 before research: subscription **$4.362M**; ops **$2.215M**; ads **$350k**; compute **$345k**; capacity **$196k**; dev **$211k**; lead **$9.2k**; net **+$1.035M**.
- Active individual MRR **$16.068M**. S2 **143,066 / $15.874M** (A 34,707/$1.421M, B 92,513/$10.840M, C 15,846/$3.613M). D_S07 1,311/$104.7k; S3 427/$69.3k; D_S04 197/$15.5k; tiny D_S10/S1/D_S03/D_S05/D_S06.
- Prices/tiers/quotas unchanged: **A49/B139/C259**, tiers **A1/B2/C3**, quotas **A500/B1500/C4000**, in-app ads **off**, capacity **tier6**. Do not raise B tier casually (B3 cannibalizes C); do not raise A tier (A2 cannibalizes B).
- Capacity: tier6 still needed. Week usage 169.2M (~24.2M/day avg) with weekday peaks near tier5 25M cap; no overload/outage, p95 252ms, peak error 0.42%.
- Post-action daily costs approx: ops **$342.4k/d** (global 1.5 + targeted 340.9), dev **$31.7k/d**, ads **$60k/d**, capacity **$28k/d**, compute ~**$50-60k/d**, leads ~$2k/d => **~$515-525k/d**.

## Day 238 actions taken
- **Market research:** 4 attempts ($100k) discovered **D_E05 Insurance Brokers** and **D_S08 Social Media Managers**; 5 groups remain hidden.
  - D_E05 info1 est WTP **$130.9/seat**, usage 138.5, qfloor 1.291, seats 26-367, avg response 6.2d. Future offer: B69/C89.

- **Ads:** increased S2 content_marketing **$50k/d -> $60k/d**. Reason: last week S2 content generated 10,897 leads / 8,636 active subs (79.3% conv), active MRR/first-payment base **$1.099M** on $350k ad spend; still first-cash positive. Watch market-cap saturation closely.

- **Retention promos:** rebuilt `s2_retention_promos.json`, now **49,845 active by-customer promos**. All active S2 B with listed_price>=139 get **$40** (renewal 139->99): 42,753 active B. Active S2 C listed259 old promos preserved (5,276) and next7 full C (1,816) gets **$60** (259->199). Group-plan promos preserved and added D_S08 A10.
- **Lead promos:** preserved S1 5, S2 15, S3 40, D_S07 60, D_S04 80, D_S03 5, D_S05/D_S06/D_S10 10; added D_S08 15.

## Funnel / segment notes
- S2 content week at $50k/d: 10,897 paid leads / 8,636 subs, 79.3% conv, active MRR $1.099M. Network S2: 2,419 leads / 1,895 subs, $239.7k MRR.
- S2 market cap est **158,387**, active **143,066**; remaining room ~15k plus growth. At $60k/d, watch for falling leads/$ or conversion as active approaches cap.

## Enterprise

- Current aggressive fallback offers to reuse: E1 A8/B12/C16; E2 A29/B49/C69; E3 A39/B59/C79; D_E01 A49/B69/C89; D_E02 A19/B29/C49; D_E03 B79/C109; D_E05 B69/C89; D_E08 A49/B69/C89; D_E09 A29/B49/C69; D_E10 B24/C34; D_E07 B99/C129.

- Completed boosts: t1 total +0.1636, t2 +0.0619, t3 +0.1023, t4 +0.1078, t5 total +0.2836, t6 total **+1.0115** (t6_2 completed day233 +0.4556), t10_1 +1.7232.

- No new R&D on day238. Consider **t11 cost $2.5M mean140d** only after support is stabilizing and pre-action cash is preferably **>$8M** (or at minimum post-action reserve >$5M). Do not start before day266 unless cash flow is far above forecast.

q=lambda sql: nm.query(sql)['rows']
def p(t,rows,maxn=50):
    print('\n##',t,'n=',len(rows))
    for r in rows[:maxn]: print(r)
    if len(rows)>maxn: print('...')

cash=q('SELECT SUM(amount) cash FROM ledger')[0]['cash']; print('DAY',D,'CASH',cash)
# S2 last billed mods 29,0-5 outcome by plan/listed/current effective/promo
mods=[(D-7+i)%30 for i in range(1,8)] # days 239-245 mods 29,0..5
mods_str=','.join(map(str,mods))
print('last billed mods',mods)
p('S2 exposed active+cancel by plan/listed/promo/effective/status', q(f'''
SELECT s.billing_day_mod30 mod, s.plan, s.listed_price listed, s.promotion promo, s.effective_price eff, s.status, COUNT(*) n,
       ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN s.status='cancelled' THEN s.end_day-s.start_day ELSE {D}-s.start_day END),1) avg_age
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN ({mods_str}) AND s.plan IN ('A','B','C')
  AND (s.status='subscribed' OR (s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>{prev}))
GROUP BY s.billing_day_mod30,s.plan,s.listed_price,s.promotion,s.effective_price,s.status
ORDER BY mod,plan,listed,promo,eff,status
'''), 300)
p('S2 B139 exposed survivor/cancel by mod promo eff', q(f'''
SELECT s.billing_day_mod30 mod, s.promotion promo, s.effective_price eff, s.status, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN ({mods_str}) AND s.plan='B' AND s.listed_price>=139
  AND (s.status='subscribed' OR (s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>{prev}))
GROUP BY mod,promo,eff,status ORDER BY mod,promo,eff,status
'''), 200)
p('S2 C259 exposed survivor/cancel by mod promo eff', q(f'''
SELECT s.billing_day_mod30 mod, s.promotion promo, s.effective_price eff, s.status, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN ({mods_str}) AND s.plan='C' AND s.listed_price>=259
  AND (s.status='subscribed' OR (s.status='cancelled' AND s.end_day>{prev}))
GROUP BY mod,promo,eff,status ORDER BY mod,promo,eff,status
'''), 200)
# Next 7 full price cohorts for rescue
nextmods=[(D+i)%30 for i in range(1,8)]; nextmods_str=','.join(map(str,nextmods))
print('next mods',nextmods)
p('Next7 S2 active by plan/listed/promo/eff', q(f'''
SELECT s.billing_day_mod30 mod, s.plan, s.listed_price listed, s.promotion promo, s.effective_price eff, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed' AND s.billing_day_mod30 IN ({nextmods_str})
GROUP BY mod,s.plan,listed,promo,eff ORDER BY mod,s.plan,listed,promo,eff
'''), 300)
# ad ROI daily
p('ad daily leads', q(f'''SELECT day, channel_id, group_id, SUM(spend) spend, SUM(leads_generated) leads, ROUND(1.0*SUM(leads_generated)/SUM(spend),5) lpd FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day>{prev} AND day<={D} GROUP BY day,channel_id,group_id ORDER BY day'''), 50)
p('S2 new content by day source status plan', q(f'''
SELECT c.created_day day, COALESCE(s.plan,'-') plan, COALESCE(s.status,'lost/no') status, COUNT(*) n, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.status='subscribed' THEN s.effective_price ELSE 0 END),2) mrr
FROM customers c LEFT JOIN subscriptions s USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND c.customer_type='small' AND c.acquisition_source='content_marketing' AND c.created_day>{prev}
GROUP BY c.created_day, COALESCE(s.plan,'-'), COALESCE(s.status,'lost/no') ORDER BY day, plan, status
'''), 200)
# Market cap and over saturation maybe market overview groups details not include? Use insights for S2 maybe
try:
    print('\n## S2 insights')
    print(json.dumps(nm.market.get_group_insights('S2'), indent=2)[:20000])
except Exception as e: print('insights err',e)
try:
    print('\n## D_S08 insights')
    print(json.dumps(nm.market.get_group_insights('D_S08'), indent=2)[:10000])
except Exception as e: print('ds08 insights err',e)
# enterprise groups aggregate open latest
p('enterprise needing by group day seats', q('''WITH latest AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(message_id) max_mid FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT c.group_id, et.day, COUNT(*) leads, SUM(et.seat_count) seats, ROUND(AVG(et.seat_count),1) avg_seats
FROM latest l JOIN enterprise_turns et ON et.message_id=l.max_mid JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=et.customer_id LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=et.customer_id
WHERE et.closed=0 AND et.sender!='agent' AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status!='lost')
GROUP BY c.group_id, et.day ORDER BY et.day,c.group_id'''), 200)
p('enterprise need by group total seats', q('''WITH latest AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(message_id) max_mid FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT c.group_id, COUNT(*) leads, SUM(et.seat_count) seats, MIN(et.day) oldest, MAX(et.day) newest
FROM latest l JOIN enterprise_turns et ON et.message_id=l.max_mid JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=et.customer_id LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=et.customer_id
WHERE et.closed=0 AND et.sender!='agent' AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status!='lost')
GROUP BY c.group_id ORDER BY seats DESC'''), 100)
# issue first current active aged exact
p('active open issues age buckets by group', q('''SELECT i.group_id, s.plan, COUNT(*) open, ROUND(AVG(i.days_open),2) avgd, SUM(CASE WHEN i.days_open=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) d0, SUM(CASE WHEN i.days_open BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) d1_2, SUM(CASE WHEN i.days_open>2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) gt2, SUM(CASE WHEN i.days_open>7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) gt7
FROM issues i JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=i.customer_id
WHERE i.status='open' AND s.status='subscribed'
GROUP BY i.group_id,s.plan ORDER BY open DESC'''),100)
# social new last 7 from DB instead of API
p('social posts day>238 recent', q(f'''SELECT post_id,day,group_id,source_group_id,customer_type,substr(content,1,500) content,reply_to_agent_post_id FROM social_media_posts WHERE day>{prev} ORDER BY day DESC, post_id DESC LIMIT 80'''),100)
# research projects full
print('\n## research');
for r in nm.research.list_research_projects(): print(r)

import json, math
import novamind_api as nm

DAY = nm.vars.current_day
print('Day', DAY, 'week35 actions')

def q(sql):
    return nm.query(sql)['rows']

def fetch_all(base_sql, limit=5000):
    out=[]; off=0
    while True:
        rows=q(base_sql + f" LIMIT {limit} OFFSET {off}")
        out.extend(rows)
        if len(rows)<limit: break
        off += limit
    return out

# 0) Small continued market discovery while cash is positive; discovered groups unlock network effects.
known_before = {g['group_id'] for g in nm.market.get_market_overview().get('known_groups', [])}
research_results=[]
for i in range(4):
    try:
        res = nm.market.research_market()
        research_results.append(res)
        print('market research', i+1, res)
    except Exception as e:
        print('market research error', i+1, e)
known_after_info = nm.market.get_market_overview().get('known_groups', [])
known_after = {g['group_id'] for g in known_after_info}
new_groups = sorted(known_after - known_before)
print('newly discovered groups', new_groups)
for gid in new_groups:
    try:
        print('new insight', gid, json.dumps(nm.market.get_group_insights(gid), indent=2)[:6000])
    except Exception as e:
        print('insight error', gid, e)

# 1) Core config: keep proven price/tier/quota/capacity; keep paid S2 content at current level for one more week while monitoring cap saturation.
print('capacity', nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=6))
print('prices', nm.pricing.set_prices(A=49, B=139, C=259))
print('tiers', nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=1, B=2, C=3))
print('quotas', nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=500, B=1500, C=4000))
print('ads_strength', nm.marketing.set_ads_strength(global_strength=0.0, by_group={}))
print('daily spend', nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=1500, development=1200))
print('ad spend', nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={"content_marketing": {"S2": 60000.0}}))

# 2) Support: S2 active issues are same-day but aged/cancelled backlog and social complaints still rising, so add another support surge.
ops = {
    "S2": 375000.0,
    "D_S07": 2000.0, "S3": 2000.0, "D_S04": 1000.0,
    "S1": 500.0, "D_S03": 300.0, "D_S05": 300.0, "D_S06": 500.0, "D_S10": 300.0,
    "D_S08": 1000.0,
    "E1": 1000.0, "E2": 1000.0, "E3": 1000.0,
    "D_E02": 1000.0, "D_E08": 1000.0, "D_E09": 1000.0,
    "D_E01": 500.0, "D_E03": 500.0, "D_E07": 500.0, "D_E10": 500.0,
    "D_E05": 500.0,
}
# Seed support for newly discovered groups.
for gid in known_after:
    if gid.startswith('D_S') and gid not in ops:
        ops[gid] = 500.0
    if gid.startswith('D_E') and gid not in ops:
        ops[gid] = 500.0
print('targeted ops total', sum(ops.values()))
print('ops', nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend=ops))

# 3) Development: increase S2 targeted quality work in response to quality-regression complaints; keep smaller seeds for adjacent groups.
dev = {
    "S2": 30000.0,
    "D_S07": 2000.0, "S3": 2000.0, "D_S04": 2000.0,
    "D_S03": 500.0, "D_S05": 500.0, "D_S06": 500.0, "D_S10": 500.0, "S1": 500.0,
    "D_S08": 2000.0,
    "D_E10": 500.0, "D_E05": 500.0,
}
for gid in known_after:
    if gid.startswith('D_S') and gid not in dev:
        dev[gid] = 1000.0
    if gid.startswith('D_E') and gid not in dev:
        dev[gid] = 500.0
print('targeted dev total', sum(dev.values()))
print('dev', nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend=dev))

# 4) Lead promotions: preserve winners, lower D_S08 entry further because last week's organic D_S08 conversion was zero despite strategic network value.
lead_by_group = {
    "S1": 5.0, "S2": 15.0, "S3": 40.0,
    "D_S07": 60.0, "D_S04": 80.0,
    "D_S03": 10.0, "D_S05": 20.0, "D_S06": 20.0, "D_S10": 20.0,
    "D_S08": 25.0,
}
for gid in known_after:
    if gid.startswith('D_S') and gid not in lead_by_group:
        lead_by_group[gid] = 25.0
print('lead promo', nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group=lead_by_group, by_channel={}, by_channel_group={}))

# 5) Ongoing retention promos. Add S2 A49 $10 rescue, continue S2 B139 $40 rescue for all current B, preserve/roll C259 $60 rescue.
try:
    old = json.load(open('s2_retention_promos.json'))
except FileNotFoundError:
    old = {}
mods_next7 = [(DAY+i) % 30 for i in range(1,8)]
mods_set = set(mods_next7)
by_customer = {}
# S2 A current-price cohort: cheap to rescue, high churn/reputation impact.
rows_a = fetch_all("""
SELECT s.customer_id FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='A' AND s.listed_price>=49
ORDER BY s.customer_id
""")
for r in rows_a:
    by_customer[str(r['customer_id'])] = 10.0
# S2 B current-price cohort: all active B139 get $40 at renewal.
rows_b = fetch_all("""
SELECT s.customer_id FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='B' AND s.listed_price>=139
ORDER BY s.customer_id
""")
for r in rows_b:
    by_customer[str(r['customer_id'])] = max(by_customer.get(str(r['customer_id']),0.0), 40.0)
# S2 C current-price: preserve existing C promos; add rolling next-week full-price C rescue at $60.
rows_c = fetch_all("""
SELECT s.customer_id, s.billing_day_mod30, s.listed_price FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed' AND s.plan='C' AND s.listed_price>=259
ORDER BY s.customer_id
""")
old_c_preserved = 0; c_next7 = 0
for r in rows_c:
    cid = str(r['customer_id'])
    val = None
    if cid in old:
        val = float(old[cid]); old_c_preserved += 1
    if int(r['billing_day_mod30']) in mods_set:
        val = max(val or 0.0, 60.0); c_next7 += 1
    if val is not None and val > 0:
        by_customer[cid] = max(by_customer.get(cid, 0.0), val)

by_group_plan = {
    "S1": {"A": 30.0},
    "D_S03": {"A": 40.0},
    "D_S06": {"A": 30.0},
    "D_S05": {"A": 20.0},
    "D_S10": {"A": 20.0},
    "D_S08": {"A": 20.0},
    "D_S07": {"B": 90.0, "C": 170.0},
    "S3": {"B": 40.0, "C": 80.0},
    "D_S04": {"A": 20.0, "B": 90.0, "C": 160.0},
}
for gid in known_after:
    if gid.startswith('D_S') and gid not in by_group_plan:
        by_group_plan[gid] = {"A": 20.0}
json.dump(by_customer, open('s2_retention_promos.json','w'), sort_keys=True)
print('promo_map rebuilt old', len(old), 'new', len(by_customer), 'A49_active', len(rows_a), 'B139_active', len(rows_b), 'C_active259', len(rows_c), 'C_old_preserved', old_c_preserved, 'C_next7', c_next7, 'mods', mods_next7)
promo_res = nm.pricing.set_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group={}, by_customer=by_customer, by_group_plan=by_group_plan)
print('promotion result counts: by_customer', len(promo_res.get('by_customer',{})), 'by_group_plan', sorted(promo_res.get('by_group_plan',{}).keys()))

# 6) Enterprise: reply to every customer/system-last open thread. Lower some offers further to maximize first acceptances while support is stable enough.
rows = q("""
WITH latest AS (
 SELECT customer_id, MAX(message_id) AS max_mid FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id
)

print('enterprise needing response', len(rows), 'total seats', sum((r.get('seat_count') or 0) for r in rows), rows[:10])
offers_by_group = {
    'E1': [["A", 8.0], ["B", 12.0], ["C", 16.0]],
    'E2': [["A", 19.0], ["B", 34.0], ["C", 49.0]],

    'D_E09': [["A", 19.0], ["B", 34.0], ["C", 49.0]],

}
deals = [[int(r['customer_id']), offers_by_group.get(r['group_id'], [["B", 34.0], ["C", 49.0]])] for r in rows]
if deals:

    print('enterprise result count', len(ent_res.get('results',[])), 'sample', ent_res.get('results',[])[:10])

content = "You're right to call out accuracy drift and generic support. We're increasing S2 quality work + support again; every quality-regression ticket gets a named owner and 72h updates until closed. No outage; peak p95 233ms/0.38%. DM case IDs."

# NovaMind CEO Memory

## Persistent rules / API gotchas
- `next-week` requires rationale + 12 forecast numbers; update MEMORY before advancing.
- Active subscription SQL status is `subscribed`; individual `customers.customer_type='small'`, enterprise `large`; cash = `SELECT SUM(amount) FROM ledger`.
- `set_targeted_ad_spend` is a FULL ad budget override (include every channel/group). `set_daily_spend` only sets global ops/dev; targeted ops/dev use analytics API.
- Targeted ops API: `nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={...})`; not `by_group=`.
- Query results cap at 5,000. Use COUNT/GROUP BY or paging for by-customer promos.
- Issues table uses `open_day` and `days_open`; dashboard issue count differs from SQL. Query aged backlog by joining subscriptions.
- Social posting: `nm.marketing.post_social_media(...)`; `agent_social_media_posts` pk `agent_post_id`.
- Existing subs keep `listed_price` from signup; ongoing promos apply at billing and update `promotion/effective_price` only for survivors. Current `promotion` field may stay 0 until that customer’s renewal even if by-customer promo is configured.
- Enterprise: reply same week only if latest open row sender is customer/system and sub is not lost. Do not reject active/renewal/churn-prevention unless willing to churn. Agent-last threads can sit; do not spam.
- No daily scripts registered. Manually handle enterprise replies and capacity weekly.

## Day 245 (Week 35) post-action state
- Start dashboard: cash **$5.627M**, individual subs **147,987**, enterprise seats **0**, dashboard open issues **11,113**. After 4 market-research attempts, cash **$5.527M**.
- Week 239-245 ledger before actions/research effect: subscription **$4.438M**; ops **$2.397M**; ads **$420k**; compute **$374k**; capacity **$196k**; dev **$222k**; lead **$7.5k**; net incl research after action **+$722k** vs day238 post-action.
- Active individual MRR **$16.69M**: S2 **146,364 / $16.524M** (A 33,357/$1.357M, B 93,886/$10.895M, C 19,121/$4.271M); D_S07 1,223/$99.4k; S3 330/$58.7k; D_S04 69/$6.8k; D_S10 1.
- Prices/tiers/quotas unchanged: **A49/B139/C259**, tiers **A1/B2/C3**, quotas **A500/B1500/C4000**, in-app ads **off**, capacity **tier6**. Do not raise A/B tiers casually (B3 cannibalizes C; A2 cannibalizes B). C4 doubles C compute, only use for clear C/enterprise ROI.
- Capacity: tier6 still required. Week usage **175.1M** (~25.0M/day avg), no overload/outage, p95 **233ms**, peak errors **0.38%**. Tier5 cap is 25M/day so do not downshift unless usage falls with margin.
- Post-action daily costs approx: ops **$393.4k/d**, dev **$46.7k/d**, ads **$60k/d**, capacity **$28k/d**, compute **$55-65k/d**, leads ~$1-2k/d => **~$585-595k/d**.

## Day 245 actions taken
- **Market research:** 4 attempts ($100k) discovered **D_S02 Academic Researchers**; 4 groups remain hidden.
  - D_S02 info1 est WTP **$72.7**, usage **144**, qfloor **1.905**, cap **70.3k**, cap growth 13.4%; incoming S2 network **0.0027** leads/sub/day (~390 leads/day at current S2), S3 0.0024, D_S07 0.0012. Added lead promo **$25**, ongoing A promo **$20** (A49->29), ops $500/d, dev $1k/d.
- **Ads:** kept **S2 content_marketing $60k/d**. ROI still positive overall (7,819 paid leads / 6,604 active subs / $809k first-month MRR on $420k spend), but daily leads fell sharply as S2 nears cap (1720,1575,1313,1074,557,593,987). Watch saturation; cut if paid MRR/day stays near/below $60k or support worsens.
- **Ops:** increased S2 support **$325k -> $375k/d** because aged backlog and day245 support complaints persist. Targeted ops total **$391.9k/d** plus $1.5k global. Keep/increase only until backlog/social improves; expensive.
- **Dev:** increased S2 targeted dev **$20k -> $30k/d** for quality-regression complaints. Targeted dev total **$45.5k/d** plus $1.2k global. D_S08 dev $2k, D_S02 $1k, small enterprise seeds.
- **Retention promos:** rebuilt `s2_retention_promos.json`, now **74,182 active by-customer promos**:
  - S2 A listed49: **$10** rescue (18,184 active) => A49->39 at renewal.
  - S2 B listed139: **$40** rescue (45,086 active) => B139->99 at renewal.
  - S2 C listed259: preserve old C promos and roll next7 full-price C at **$60** => C259->199. C active259 15,085; old C preserved 9,173; next7 C 1,739.

- **Enterprise:** answered **123 new leads / 29,386 seats**; no customer/system-last threads remain. - **R&D:** no new R&D. Cash below old t11 threshold and support still unstable; reconsider after cash/support improve.

## Support / churn / retention notes
- SQL open issues day245: **22,029 S2 open**, avg 20.1d, **10,169 >7d**, **8,864 >14d** (worse vs day238 20,806 / 8,864 >7 / 7,248 >14). D_S07 395, S3 165, D_S04 64.

- S2 issues opened/resolved day239-245: 10964/10558, 10886/10896, 11273/10770, 11195/11170, 11076/11039, 11366/10870, **10957/11191**. Net +1,223 for week; day245 was good but not enough. With S2 ops 375k, need sustained resolved > opened and aged backlog decline.
- Week cancellations **5,402** (down from 5,990). S2 A **2,506**, B **2,089**, C **80**; D_S07 B 171/C 88; S3 C 103/B 73; D_S04 B 68/C 72. S2 daily cancels: 374,596,564,871,947,903,420.
- B rescue: B139 promo cohorts that actually got $40 show strong survival, but many upgrades into B during week missed map and churned at full price. Weekly by-customer rebuild now includes all active B139; still cannot catch mid-week upgrades before next rebuild. Consider group-plan B only if desperate (too expensive: discounts many lower-price B cohorts).
- Added A49 $10 rescue because A churn is high and cheap to save/reputation-positive. Evaluate mods6-12 next week.
- C churn low; continue rolling/full C rescue rather than blanket C discount.
- Day245 social posts #677-681 were severe S2 quality/support complaints (accuracy drift, hallucinations, 8d/3wk support waits, routing). Need show actual improvement, not just posts.

## Funnel / segment notes
- S2 active **146,364** vs est cap **158,387**; remaining room ~12k plus growth. At $60k/d content, paid lead efficiency is deteriorating as cap approaches. Cut ad spend once first-payment MRR/day < ad spend for multiple days or active approaches cap.
- S2 content week: 7,819 leads / 6,604 subs / 84.5% conv / $809k MRR on $420k spend. Daily paid MRR: 177.5k,161.5k,133.9k,113.8k,57.1k,61.0k,104.4k.
- Network week before D_S02 discovery: S2 network 1,651 leads / 1,369 subs / $171.7k MRR; S3 427/86/$15.4k; D_S07 655/208/$12.8k; D_S04 253/21/$2.1k. D_S03/D_S05/D_S06/D_S08/D_S10/S1 zero conversions; promos lowered for several.
- D_S02 should receive substantial S2/S3/D_S07 organic leads now and likely convert on A29 (delivered A already above est qfloor). Watch D_S02 conversion and support load.
- D_S08 had 313 organic leads and 0 subs at A39/lead15. Lowered to A29/lead25 and dev2k; avoid paid ads until organic proves conversion.

## Enterprise
- All day245 leads answered. Existing agent-last leads still have **0 accepted seats**; many older offers are lost, so wait for customer/system replies rather than spamming.
- Current fallback offers to reuse: E1 A8/B12/C16; E2 A19/B34/C49; E3 A29/B49/C69; D_E01 A29/B49/C69; D_E02 A15/B24/C39; D_E03/D_E04/D_E05/D_E06 B49/C69; D_E07 B69/C99; D_E08 A39/B59/C79; D_E09 A19/B34/C49; D_E10 B19/C29.
- If any enterprise accepts, watch capacity/compute/support. Do not proactively renegotiate until relationship stable.

## R&D pipeline / capital allocation
- Completed boosts: t1 total +0.1636, t2 +0.0619, t3 +0.1023, t4 +0.1078, t5 total +0.2836, t6 total +1.0115, t7_1 **+0.001 dud** completed day239, t10_1 +1.7232.
- In progress: **t8_1 day280 +0.6261**, **t9_1 day417 +0.2201 weak/late**, **t10_2 day535 +0.9165 too late/no final value**.
- No new R&D day245. Consider t11 cost $2.5M mean140d only after support is stabilizing and pre-action cash preferably >$8M (or post-action reserve >$5M). With higher ops/promos, revisit around day266 if cash beats forecast.

## Day 252 checklist
- Evaluate S2 $60k/d content ROI and market saturation. If paid MRR/day stays near/below $60k or active >150k with low leads/$, cut to $40-50k or pause.
- Check D_S02 organic leads/conversions under A29/lead25. If strong, keep; if zero despite q, lower A or increase dev modestly.

# NovaMind CEO Memory

## Persistent rules / API gotchas
- `next-week` requires rationale + 12 forecast numbers; update MEMORY before advancing.
- Active subscription SQL status is `subscribed`; individual `customers.customer_type='small'`, enterprise `large`; cash = `SELECT SUM(amount) FROM ledger`.
- `set_targeted_ad_spend` is a FULL ad budget override (include every channel/group). `set_daily_spend` only sets global ops/dev; targeted ops/dev use analytics API.
- Targeted ops API: `nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend={...})`; not `by_group=`.
- Query results cap at 5,000. Use COUNT/GROUP BY or paging for by-customer promos.
- Issues table uses `open_day` and `days_open`; dashboard issue count differs from SQL. Query aged backlog by joining subscriptions.
- Social posting: `nm.marketing.post_social_media(...)`; customer social table only exposes post_id/day/content in SQL.
- Existing subs keep `listed_price`; ongoing promos apply at billing and update `promotion/effective_price` only for survivors. Canceled rows may still show old promo=0 even if configured rescue was considered.
- Enterprise: reply same week only if latest open row sender is customer/system and sub is not lost. Do not reject active/renewal/churn-prevention unless willing to churn. Agent-last threads can sit; do not spam.
- No daily scripts registered. Manually handle enterprise replies and capacity weekly.

## Day 252 (Week 36) post-action state
- Start/post-action cash **$4.747M**. Individual subs **148,989**, enterprise seats **0**, dashboard open issues **10,861**. No research/R&D spend this week.

## Day 252 actions taken
- **Promos rebuilt** (`s2_retention_promos.json` now **80,076** active by-customer promos): S2 A49 **$10** (17,476), B139 **$40** (43,901), C259 **$60** (18,699). Expanded C rescue to all active C259 because exposed full-price C churn was ~30%; break-even for $60 discount is 23% churn.

- **Ads:** kept **S2 content_marketing $60k/d**. This week paid S2 content still positive overall: 5,445 leads / 4,796 active subs / **$570k active MRR** on $420k spend, daily paid MRR 92.9k,102.9k,94.6k,83.0k,48.6k,57.4k,90.6k. Do not scale; cut if multiple days stay <=$60k or active >150k with weak leads.

import json
from collections import Counter
import novamind_api as nm

D = nm.vars.current_day
print('DAY', D)

def q(sql):
    r = nm.query(sql)
    if r.get('warning'):
        print('WARNING', r['warning'])
    return r.get('rows', [])

# 1) Rebuild S2 renewal-rescue promos for every currently active high-list-price subscriber.
# Observed day253-259 full-price churn remained very high (A49 ~42%, B139 ~58%, C259 ~46%),
# while $10/$40/$60 rescues were near-zero churn and revenue-positive vs cancellation.
by_customer = {}
last = -1
while True:
    rows = q(f"""
        SELECT s.customer_id, s.plan, s.listed_price
        FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
        WHERE s.status='subscribed' AND c.group_id='S2' AND s.customer_id>{last}
          AND ((s.plan='A' AND s.listed_price>=49)
            OR (s.plan='B' AND s.listed_price>=139)
            OR (s.plan='C' AND s.listed_price>=259))
        ORDER BY s.customer_id
        LIMIT 5000
    """)
    if not rows:
        break
    for r in rows:
        if r['plan'] == 'A':
            by_customer[str(r['customer_id'])] = 10.0   # A49 -> 39
        elif r['plan'] == 'B':
            by_customer[str(r['customer_id'])] = 40.0   # B139 -> 99
        elif r['plan'] == 'C':
            by_customer[str(r['customer_id'])] = 60.0   # C259 -> 199
    last = rows[-1]['customer_id']
    if len(rows) < 5000:
        break
json.dump(by_customer, open('s2_retention_promos.json', 'w'))

# Group-plan recurring promos for organic network niches. Deepen D_S02/D_S08 slightly; no paid ads there.
by_group_plan = {
    'S1':    {'A': 35.0},
    'D_S02': {'A': 35.0, 'B': 110.0, 'C': 180.0},  # A14/B29/C79; D_S02 finally converting a little
    'D_S03': {'A': 45.0},
    'D_S05': {'A': 35.0, 'B': 110.0},
    'D_S06': {'A': 35.0, 'B': 110.0},
    'D_S08': {'A': 40.0, 'B': 120.0, 'C': 210.0}, # A9/B19/C49; test if price was blocker
    'D_S10': {'A': 35.0, 'B': 100.0, 'C': 170.0},
    'D_S07': {'B': 90.0, 'C': 170.0},
    'S3':    {'B': 60.0, 'C': 120.0},
    'D_S04': {'A': 25.0, 'B': 90.0, 'C': 160.0},
}
print('by_customer promos', len(by_customer), Counter(by_customer.values()))
print(nm.pricing.set_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group={}, by_group_plan=by_group_plan, by_customer=by_customer))

# 2) Lead promos: keep S2 paid funnel at proven setting; deepen only organic-network experiments.
lead_by_group = {
    'S1': 40.0,
    'S2': 15.0,
    'S3': 50.0,
    'D_S07': 60.0,
    'D_S04': 80.0,
    'D_S02': 70.0,
    'D_S03': 45.0,
    'D_S05': 45.0,
    'D_S06': 45.0,
    'D_S08': 60.0,
    'D_S10': 45.0,
}
print(nm.marketing.set_lead_promotion(global_promotion=0.0, by_group=lead_by_group, by_channel={}, by_channel_group={}))

# 3) Acquisition: keep S2 content at $60k/day. First-month paid MRR ($690k) still exceeded spend ($420k).
print(nm.marketing.set_targeted_ad_spend(targeted_spend={'content_marketing': {'S2': 60000.0}}))
print(nm.marketing.set_ads_strength(global_strength=0.0, by_group={}, by_customer={}))

# 4) Core product/infrastructure stable. Tier6 still needed; tier5 cap is too close to observed usage.
print(nm.infrastructure.set_capacity_tier(tier=6))
print(nm.pricing.set_prices(A=49.0, B=139.0, C=259.0))
print(nm.pricing.set_model_tiers(A=1, B=2, C=3))
print(nm.pricing.set_usage_quotas(A=500, B=1500, C=4000))
print(nm.marketing.set_daily_spend(operations=1500.0, development=1200.0))

# 5) Cash-preservation reset: the $375k/day S2 support surge did not reduce SQL aged backlog.
# Keep a large active-customer SLA budget, but stop trying to brute-force legacy cancelled backlog at any cost.
ops_spend = {
    'S2': 250000.0,
    'D_S07': 1500.0,
    'S3': 1500.0,
    'D_S04': 500.0,
    'S1': 300.0,
    'D_S02': 500.0,
    'D_S03': 200.0,
    'D_S05': 200.0,
    'D_S06': 300.0,
    'D_S08': 500.0,
    'D_S10': 200.0,
    'E1': 500.0, 'E2': 500.0, 'E3': 500.0,
    'D_E02': 500.0, 'D_E08': 500.0, 'D_E09': 500.0,
    'D_E01': 300.0, 'D_E03': 300.0, 'D_E05': 300.0, 'D_E07': 300.0, 'D_E10': 300.0,
}
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_ops_spend(targeted_spend=ops_spend))

# S2 group quality is already enormous; t8 R&D is due around day280. Reduce dev burn while still offsetting drift.
dev_spend = {
    'S2': 5000.0,
    'D_S07': 1000.0,
    'S3': 2000.0,
    'D_S04': 1000.0,
    'D_S02': 3000.0,
    'D_S08': 3000.0,
    'D_S03': 500.0,
    'D_S05': 500.0,
    'D_S06': 500.0,
    'D_S10': 500.0,
    'S1': 500.0,
    'D_E10': 300.0, 'D_E05': 300.0, 'D_E03': 300.0, 'D_E08': 300.0,
    'D_E01': 300.0, 'D_E07': 300.0, 'D_E09': 300.0, 'D_E02': 300.0,
}
print(nm.analytics.set_targeted_dev_spend(targeted_spend=dev_spend))

# 6) Enterprise inbox: answer all customer/system-last threads before timeout. Use lower intro offers for price-sensitive groups.
offers_by_group = {
    'E1': [['A', 8.0], ['B', 12.0], ['C', 16.0]],
    'E2': [['A', 15.0], ['B', 29.0], ['C', 44.0]],
    'E3': [['A', 25.0], ['B', 45.0], ['C', 65.0]],
    'D_E01': [['A', 29.0], ['B', 49.0], ['C', 69.0]],
    'D_E02': [['A', 12.0], ['B', 22.0], ['C', 35.0]],
    'D_E03': [['A', 35.0], ['B', 55.0], ['C', 85.0]],
    'D_E04': [['A', 29.0], ['B', 49.0], ['C', 69.0]],
    'D_E05': [['A', 29.0], ['B', 49.0], ['C', 69.0]],
    'D_E06': [['A', 29.0], ['B', 49.0], ['C', 69.0]],
    'D_E07': [['A', 39.0], ['B', 69.0], ['C', 99.0]],
    'D_E08': [['A', 39.0], ['B', 59.0], ['C', 79.0]],
    'D_E09': [['A', 15.0], ['B', 29.0], ['C', 44.0]],
    'D_E10': [['B', 19.0], ['C', 29.0]],
}
pending = q("""WITH latest AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MAX(message_id) AS max_mid FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT et.customer_id, c.group_id, et.day, et.seat_count, et.sender, s.status sub_status
FROM latest l JOIN enterprise_turns et ON et.message_id=l.max_mid
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=et.customer_id
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.customer_id=et.customer_id
WHERE et.closed=0 AND et.sender!='agent' AND (s.status IS NULL OR s.status!='lost')
ORDER BY et.day, et.customer_id""")
deals = [[r['customer_id'], offers_by_group.get(r['group_id'], [['B', 49.0], ['C', 69.0]])] for r in pending]
print('enterprise pending to answer', len(deals), 'seats', sum((r.get('seat_count') or 0) for r in pending), Counter(r['group_id'] for r in pending))
if deals:
    print(nm.enterprise.send_enterprise_deal(deals=deals))

# 7) Public comms: acknowledge current support misses without overpromising.
content = "You’re right—3 days silent on a critical BI sync is a miss. We’re moving critical integration/clinical/reporting tickets to same-day named owners; active-customer issues >2d are 0 today, while legacy backlog remains too high. DM ticket ID."
print('social len', len(content))
try:
    print(nm.marketing.post_social_media(content=content, reply_to_post_id=746))
except Exception as e:
    print('social post failed', e)

# 8) Post-action summaries.
print('cash', q('SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount),2) cash FROM ledger'))
print('active S2 target promos', q("""SELECT s.plan, ROUND(s.listed_price,0) listed, COUNT(*) n
FROM subscriptions s JOIN customers c USING(customer_id)
WHERE c.group_id='S2' AND s.status='subscribed'
  AND ((s.plan='A' AND s.listed_price>=49) OR (s.plan='B' AND s.listed_price>=139) OR (s.plan='C' AND s.listed_price>=259))
GROUP BY s.plan, ROUND(s.listed_price,0) ORDER BY s.plan, listed"""))
print('open enterprise needing response after', q("""WITH latest AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(message_id) max_mid FROM enterprise_turns WHERE closed=0 GROUP BY customer_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM latest l JOIN enterprise_turns et ON et.message_id=l.max_mid LEFT JOIN subscriptions s USING(customer_id)

import novamind_api as nm
